text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

The candidate who won is also a woman, so an all-female panel can't readily explain a decision made against you on grounds of sex. There's no mechanism here — and raising it would likely read as sour grapes and damage your standing in a sector where reputation travels.

Four women on a panel is also unremarkable in municipal planning and HR-led recruitment; it's not evidence of anything.

The real issue is your unanswered request. Follow up in writing with HR, citing the two-week delay, and ask specifically what criteria were weighted and how you scored. "Extensive public consultation experience" suggests they prioritised community engagement over credentials — useful feedback, and a legitimate, if debatable, choice.
